messages:
Incidents Bot: PAGER: smart-routing-service high error-rate in us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 fallback loop. Impacting AcmeApp (prod).

Ops Pager: paging @jordan (oncall), @ravi (sre) :phone: ...

Jordan T: taking pager. on it. checking dashboards.

Ravi K: seeing 5xx spike and request traces showing retry loop, latencies 2-8s. Could be model variant incompat.

Sophia L: support noticed customer reports of tool-calling failures (webhook not firing).

Maria G: confirm: requests with tool_call:true are failing with "tool_not_supported" after fallback.

Alex B: logs show original candidate was "gptx-fp16-tooling" then fallback to "gptx-quant-v1" which doesn't support tool calling -> router re-routes to other region that has fp16 variant -> then fallback back. loop.

Leo M: pasting relevant logs:
```
[2026-03-10T12:00:03Z] route_decision: prefer=us-west-2 model=gptx-fp16-tooling
[2026-03-10T12:00:03Z] serve_error: model_unavailable, fallback -> gptx-quant-v1 (eu-west-1)
[2026-03-10T12:00:03Z] response: error=tool_not_supported
[2026-03-10T12:00:04Z] router: retry -> prefer=eu-west-1 model=gptx-fp16 (non-tool)
```

Jordan T: good signal. looks like routing policy allows cross-region fallback to quantized variant without checking feature parity.

Ravi K: temp mitigation idea: disable cross-region fallback for AcmeApp (tenant id 1209) and pin model variants to tool-capable family. doing runbook step now.

Ops Pager: runbook cmd:
```
# block cross-region fallback for tenant 1209
redwoodctl routing update --tenant 1209 --policy "no-cross-region-fallback"
# pin to model family
redwoodctl model pin --tenant 1209 --model-family gptx-fp16-tooling
```

Maria G: executed both commands. monitoring.

Support Bot: Customer alert sent: "We are investigating increased errors for API requests involving tool calls. Temporary mitigation in progress."

Sophia L: can we quantify impact? metrics show ~12% of requests to AcmeApp failing with tool errors; error budget at 60% used for the day.

Alex B: also saw a config diff in commit 1a2b3c that relaxed compatibility checks in smart-routing. @ravi can you roll that back or patch?

Ravi K: rollback ready, performing a canary rollback on routing-service.

[12:30 UTC] Ravi K: rollback applied, routing-service 2 instances back to previous config. error-rate dropping.

Jordan T: confirmed decreased retries; latency back to normal for most users.

Ops Pager: handoff: @jordan will keep monitoring for 1hr, then @leo will take overnight watch. Passing pager to Jordan.

Jordan T: taking handoff. I'll run the compatibility matrix audit tomorrow and open a follow-up ticket.

Maria G: ticket created: INC-2026-142 routing compatibility check + unit tests for quant vs fp16/tool-call capability. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-142

Support Bot: customers notified of resolution once stable.

Incidents Bot: Incident resolved: root cause misconfigured fallback that didn't validate model feature parity (tool calling + context length). Postmortem scheduled 2026-03-11 15:00 UTC.

Jordan T: adding a short mitigation summary for postmortem notes:
- Disabled cross-region fallback for impacted tenant
- Pinned model family to tool-capable variants
- Rolled back routing config change that removed compatibility checks

Ravi K: follow-ups: add pre-deploy check in routing-service CI to verify variant capability mapping, and expose a telemetry gauge for cross-region fallback counts.

Leo M: thanks all. leaving log snippets and actions in the ticket.

Jordan T: will update after the watch period ends. :thumbsup:
